::: {#exm-beats}
#### The relation "beats"

By @sol-beats, the relation "beats" on $G = \set{\text{rock}, \text{paper}, \text{scissors}}$ (@rem-relation-on-set) is

$$
B = \set{(\text{rock}, \text{scissors}), (\text{scissors}, \text{paper}), (\text{paper}, \text{rock})}.
$$

So $\text{rock} \mathrel{B} \text{scissors}$,
but $(\text{scissors}, \text{rock}) \notin B$,
since the first entry of each pair is the winner.

:::
